summary_en: EXEO Group will cancel 2,000,000 shares on November 30, 2026, representing 0.97% of issued shares before cancellation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 6, 2026, the Board of Directors of EXEO Group resolved to cancel 2,000,000 treasury shares of the company pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to become effective on November 30, 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 0.97% of the issued share capital (excluding treasury shares) as of the cancellation date. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares (including treasury shares) will be 203,624,838.
